## What it is

Solid Ø36 column on the tower axis, Z 18.7 to 47.0. It stands on the adapter's seat through a bottom socket and carries the cup grille's seat in a top socket. Weak magnets (two Ø5 x 2) in the bottom socket's ceiling, strong magnets (two Ø8 x 3) in the top socket's floor. Printed upright as modelled, bottom on the bed. Bambu PETG Basic.

## Design notes

- Modelled in the machine frame and ends with `scale_frame`.
- Both sockets are `scale_seat` with the seat height plus the socket clearance (0.5), so their flanks coincide with the bosses and the ceiling or floor stays 0.5 clear. Checked numerically: the boss is a subset of its socket for both joints.
- Lower joint: well depth = magnet height + `weak_magnet_gap` - adapter magnet recess (0.2) - socket clearance (0.5) = 2.3 at the default gap of 1.0. The parameter defaults to the layout value; raise it to weaken the joint.
- Upper joint: wells in the socket floor going down, depth = magnet height (flush), the grille's are flush too, so the pair is 0.5 apart.
- The bottom socket's ceiling is a 20 mm bridge; the 5.2 mm well tops are small bridges above it (two `hole_ceiling` warnings, same two wells, accepted: a 5 mm bridge prints fine).
- Plastic: the lower wells leave a 1.1 mm flat of ceiling to the socket's edge and the full body above; the upper wells are 15 mm clear of the lower ones.
- Lightening is not wanted: solid body, infill makes it light.
- Polish: 1 mm on the outer top rim only. Nothing on the bed face or the sockets.

## Don't

- Do not chamfer the socket edges or flanks: they mate.
- Do not hollow it out.
- Do not edit the well depth by hand: change `weak_magnet_gap`.
- Do not remove the final `scale_frame`: without it the part prints as its mirror image (found 2026-11-16: the PCB box came out on the wrong side of the cell).

## Changelog

- 2026-11-16 - First model: column, two sockets, two weak and two strong magnet wells.
- 2026-11-16 - Ends with `scale_frame` (Y reversed): the machine frame is left-handed, so the part was the mirror image of the real object.
- 2026-11-17 - 2 mm taller (bottom 20.7 -> 18.7): the base's floor went 4 -> 2 mm and the cell came down with it; the top stays under the cup grille.
- 2026-11-17 - Magnet wells at the magnet's nominal diameter (`aimant_puit_press_fit` +0.15 -> 0.0): the +0.15 wells did not hold the magnets at all. On trial.
- 2026-11-17 - Magnet wells +0.10 over the magnet's diameter (`aimant_puit_press_fit` 0.0 -> 0.10): 0.0 was too tight. On trial.
